title: Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Interest: Counting the Interest Days
content:
**Term Life Insurance — interest days for reinstatement interest.** The interest days are counted by one of three methods, chosen by the lapse gap (the number of calendar days from the lapse date on record to the date the approved reinstatement application was signed):

| Lapse gap | Interest days counted |
|---|---|
| 15 days or less | from the date the reinstatement application was signed to today |
| 16 through 120 days | from the lapse date to today |
| more than 120 days | from the paid-to date at lapse to today |

All counts are calendar days.

### Worked cases (hypothetical; paid-to date at lapse 1 January 2026, lapse date 2 February 2026, today 1 July 2026)

- Application signed 10 February 2026 (gap 8 days): interest days from 10 February to 1 July, which is 141.
- Application signed 1 April 2026 (gap 58 days): from 2 February to 1 July, which is 149.
- Application signed 15 June 2026 (gap 133 days): from 1 January to 1 July, which is 181.
